scenes.tts: You need four gallon zip bags, about two cups of vegetable shortening, tape, and a bowl of ice water.
scenes.narration: You need four gallon zip bags, about two cups of vegetable shortening, tape, and a bowl of ice water.

scenes.tts: Make two mittens from pairs of bags. Put shortening between one pair, and nothing between the other. Tape the tops. Then dip both into ice water, up to the wrist.

items.text: Shortening in one, nothing in the other

scenes.narration: Make two mittens from pairs of bags. Put shortening between one pair, and nothing between the other. Tape the tops. Then dip both into ice water, up to the wrist.

scenes.tts: The plain mitten hand usually feels cold well before the other one. Your times will vary. The fat slows the heat leaving, as blubber does for a seal.
scenes.narration: The plain mitten hand usually feels cold well before the other one. Your times will vary. The fat slows the heat leaving, as blubber does for a seal.

scenes.tts: Stay with your child the whole time, and never leave the bowl of water alone. Every try stops at one minute, and your child can pull a hand out any time. Stop at once if a hand hurts.
